* Landspeed 1 is the character default, not a number printed on the slip.<ref name="character-default">[[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Decipher Glossary (1998)]], PDF page 34; [[Media:SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf|Advanced Rulebook (2023)]], PDF page 77.</ref>
